'''Trade Federation maintenance droids''' were bulky, primitive, treaded [[Droid/Legends|droids]] designed to remove dust and debris from the ventilation shafts of [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleships]]. Their electric shocks eradicated most unwanted material with enough power to injure [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and presumably most other carbon-based organisms. They were also motion-sensitive, so that they zapped anything that moved.

==History==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] met some of these droids in the ventilation shafts of the [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']].
